0022600134.text: The Pistons (3-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) host the Hornets (3-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East) in the fifth game of Detroit's 2026-27 season, with Detroit coming off a loss while Charlotte has won its last two. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pistons won all three of their 2025-26 meetings, including a 118-100 win in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
